terra.problem: The woodcarving joke places Papa Dorin in the Israelites' camp during the Bible event.
The text says the people came and brought offerings, but does not say they came back to Moses.
The text does not say the people were wearing the jewelry they brought.
The verse does not list cups and bowls, but that does not establish that nobody hauled a tableware set across the camp.
The verse does not list shields, but it does not say there was not a single shield in the pile.
The wording can place both Bezalel and Oholiab in the tribe of Dan. Bezalel was from Judah; Oholiab was from Dan.
Saying their hands never stopped coming goes beyond morning after morning. The people were later restrained from bringing more.
The text does not say that no big meeting was called.
The craftsmen report more than enough contributions for the work. That does not establish that they were short on nothing at all.
The text says there was more than enough, but does not say how much extra there was.
